verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents its own management API, authenticated with environment secret keys or personal access tokens. Run handles let code check status, cancel, and retry runs, and CLI commands cover projects, runs, and environments. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full parity with the dashboard. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and some dashboard actions (such as prompt overrides) have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec or full endpoint reference, API coverage of dashboard-only actions like prompt overrides and run filtering/inspection, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
